description: Canonical AEAD construction profiles used where an Arkret wire object selects an AEAD independently of an MLS ciphersuite or HPKE suite.
registry_rules: canonical_id values are exact wire values and MUST be unique
An AEAD profile names only the AEAD construction, key/nonce/tag sizes and AAD contract; it MUST NOT encode KEM or KDF semantics
HPKE callers select a registered HPKE suite separately and MUST verify that its aead field agrees with this profile
Unknown or inactive profiles fail closed
